title: 60 Second French Twist Updo Hair Tutorial
description:
Today’s how to hair tutorial is an easy French Twist hairstyle that takes less than 60 seconds to create. This French roll updo is a great long hair hairstyle and medium hair hairstyle. This easy updo is effortless and quick which is very on trend for 2025. It is the perfect hairstyle for bridal, weddings, prom or even for work and everyday. This look was inspired by my previous French twist hairstyle which is a more classic traditional look.
